item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
What's New

  • The app is now available in German, French, Korean and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • On macOS 27, use touch to drag cards and scenes, finish editing and use display and Now Playing controls.

Improvements

  • Releases are signed and notarized, so new downloads open without the quarantine workaround.
  • Configuration backups import across editions.
  • Lite hides Pro-only leftovers in menus, settings search and copy.

Bug Fixes

  • Leaving Wallpaper Automation during a preview restores the display's own wallpaper.
  • Keep a wallpaper change when a later cleanup step fails, and fix a possible video playback crash.
  • Pro: show Workshop text exactly as written, and stop crafted shaders from crashing or hanging the app.
  • Pro: improve Now Playing permission retries, timelines and artwork refresh.
